title: Vulkan: Lost Planet
description:
ALSO RECOMMENDED FOR YOU:

Об игре

Choose between 5 weapons cards, Upgrade your abilities in this insane top-down shooter!

ABOUT THE GAME
Arriving at the Lost Planet, Vulkan is surrounded by an variety of hostile creatures in his last mission as an intergalactic bounty-hunter.

KEY FEATURES

- Six weapons each one with unique abilities.
- Upgrade your character to increase your chances of surviving.
- Hardcore gameplay packed with action 
- Enemies A.I will go hard on you every time you kill more of them
- Unique Hand-drawn characters and backgrounds
